description: Implement the rich, responsive React UI for BOTH flows on top of the FEAT-001 scaffold, preserving 100% of the existing functionality and the exact API/auth contract. Public flow: card-based quiz list, quiz-taking screen with a progress indicator, and an engaging result screen with per-question correct/incorrect feedback (using the answerIndex returned by submit to show the right answer). Admin flow: Cognito Hosted UI login/logout, an authenticated dynamic quiz-builder form with the SAME validation rules and the SAME answerIndex-over-non-empty-options semantics, sessionStorage token handling, and 401/403 handling. Also delete the old vanilla frontend files. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: Implement frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx as the public quiz flow using the api client from src/api.ts. Manage view state ('list' | 'quiz' | 'result') and a status/error line (mirror the old setStatus semantics incl. an error style). On mount, call getQuizzes() and render a rich card-based list: each quiz as a clickable card showing title and 'ぜん N もん'/'全N問' question count (keep the old '（全N問）' wording). Empty state: 'クイズがありません。'. Errors: show the thrown Error.message in the status line with error styling.

In HomePage, on selecting a quiz call getQuiz(quizId) and render the quiz-taking screen: show the title, a progress indicator (e.g. answered X / total, or a step bar), and each question (q.n, q.text) with its options as radio inputs grouped by name 'q'+q.n. Track selected answers in state keyed by q.n. Provide '回答する' (submit) and '一覧に戻る' (back to list) actions. On submit, build answers = quiz.questions.map(q => selected[q.n] ?? -1) (an array of numbers, -1 for unanswered, matching old app.js) and call submitAnswers(quizId, answers).

In HomePage, render an engaging result screen from SubmitResult: prominent score 'score / total' (keep the old '正解数: X / Y' text available, styled richly e.g. a score ring/percentage), and a per-question breakdown list marking each q.n correct/incorrect with color (green/red) mirroring old '.correct'/'.incorrect'. Use result.results[].answerIndex (returned by the submit endpoint) plus the loaded quiz question options to also SHOW the correct option text for wrong answers (a richness improvement; keep it robust if a question is missing). Provide 'もう一度クイズを選ぶ' to reload the list.

Implement frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx as the admin flow using src/auth.ts + src/api.ts. On mount: restoreToken() then captureTokenFromHash() (handle the returned error by showing 'ログインに失敗しました: <error>'); derive isAuthenticated = token present and Date.now() < expiresAt. Render a login view when unauthenticated ('クイズを登録するにはログインが必要です。' + 'ログイン' button that navigates to loginUrl(); a link back to the public app) and the admin view when authenticated (a 'ログアウト' button navigating to logoutUrl() after clearToken(); a link back to the public app).

In AdminPage, implement the dynamic quiz-builder form with React state (not manual DOM building). State: title, optional quizId, and a list of questions where each question has text and a list of option rows (each option row has text and an isCorrect flag; correctness is single-select per question like a radio). Controls: 'タイトル' input; 'クイズ ID（任意 / 半角英数字とハイフン）' input; per question a 'this question' fieldset with a '問題文' input, 2-4 option rows each with a correct radio + text input + a '削除' button (disabled when only 2 rows remain, min 2 enforced), a '選択肢を追加' button (max 4), and a 'この問題を削除' button; a '問題を追加' button; a '登録する' submit button. Start with one question having two empty option rows (mirror old initial state).

In AdminPage, implement collectPayload() mirroring the old admin.js validation EXACTLY, throwing Error with the SAME Japanese messages: title required ('タイトルを入力してください。'); >=1 question ('問題を 1 つ以上追加してください。'); each question text required ('問題 N の問題文を入力してください。'); build options from NON-EMPTY trimmed option texts, require >=2 ('問題 N には空でない選択肢を 2 つ以上入力してください。'); a correct option must be selected ('問題 N の正解を選択してください。'); compute answerIndex over ONLY the non-empty options (skip blanks when counting, exactly like the old code) and if the selected correct row is blank error 'problem N の正解は空でない選択肢を選んでください。' (use the exact old string '問題 N の正解は空でない選択肢を選んでください。'); optional quizId must match /^[a-z0-9-]+$/ else 'クイズ ID は半角英小文字・数字・ハイフンのみ使用できます。'. Payload shape { title, questions:[{text, options, answerIndex}], quizId? }.

In AdminPage submit handler: preventDefault; run collectPayload() (on throw show message in status with error style and stop); re-check isAuthenticated (if not, show 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）' and switch to login view); set status '登録中...'; call createQuiz(payload, idToken). On AuthError/401 clear the token, switch to login view, show 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）'. On 403 show '権限がありません'. On success render a result panel: heading 'クイズを登録しました。' (green), a line 'クイズ ID: <quizId> / 問題数: <questionCount>', and a link back to the public quiz app (a react-router Link to '/').

Delete the old vanilla frontend files now fully superseded: frontend/app.js, frontend/admin.js, frontend/config.js, frontend/styles.css, frontend/admin.html, and the old frontend/index.html (the NEW Vite frontend/index.html from FEAT-001 replaces it). Confirm no remaining reference to these files exists in amplify.yml, README.md, or anywhere in the repo (grep).

Ensure the whole frontend type-checks and builds: all TSX uses the typed api/auth modules; no `any` leaks that would fail strict mode; imports of react-router-dom (Link/useNavigate) are correct for v6. This is validated by reading in-sandbox and by `npm run build` on the user's machine.
acceptance_criteria: Public flow works end to end against the real API contract: list (cards) -> take quiz (radios + progress indicator) -> submit builds answers:number[] with -1 for unanswered -> result screen shows score/total and per-question correct/incorrect with color, using submit's answerIndex to reveal correct options.

Admin flow works end to end: Cognito Hosted UI login (implicit grant) captures id_token from the hash into sessionStorage with the 60s margin, authenticated create-quiz form posts Authorization: Bearer <id_token> to POST {API_BASE}/admin/quizzes, logout uses the Cognito logout URL, and 401 (clear+re-login) / 403 (permission denied) are handled.
The admin form's validation and the answerIndex-over-non-empty-options computation produce byte-identical payloads and identical Japanese error messages to the old admin.js for equivalent input.

The UI is visually rich and responsive: card-based list, progress indicator, engaging result screen, mobile-friendly layout, and dark-mode support (from FEAT-001 styles), with a reasonable dependency count (react, react-dom, react-router-dom only).
All old vanilla files (frontend/app.js, admin.js, config.js, styles.css, admin.html, and the old index.html) are removed and nothing in the repo references them.
`cd frontend && npm run build` (on the user's networked machine) type-checks (tsc -b, strict) and produces frontend/dist with no errors.
verification: In-sandbox: read HomePage.tsx and AdminPage.tsx and confirm the API calls, answers array construction (-1 for unanswered), result rendering, Cognito login/logout URLs, token capture/margin, sessionStorage key, and the collectPayload validation + answerIndex-over-non-empty-options logic match lambda/index.ts and the old app.js/admin.js exactly (including the exact Japanese strings).
In-sandbox: grep the whole repo to confirm no reference remains to app.js/admin.js/config.js/styles.css/admin.html and that the old vanilla files are deleted.
In-sandbox: reason through TypeScript strictness (no untyped anys, correct react-router-dom v6 usage) so the build would pass.

On networked machine (documented for user): `cd frontend && env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm install && env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build` succeeds and emits frontend/dist; manual smoke test of both flows against a deployed API.
